title: Guidelines for the design of grout curtains, Part 1: Earth and rockfill dams
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard provides the following: a) Guidelines for the design of grout curtains in alluvium and rock when used as principal measure of seepage control; and b) Guidelines for the design of grout curtains which are used as principal measure of seepage control for masonry and concrete dams founded on rock mass.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Pressure grouting of rock foundations in river valley projects - Recommendations

clause_3_terminology: Guidelines for the design of grout curtains
Guidelines for the design of grout curtains, Part 1: Earth and rockfill dams

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
